IS correctly bound to the live Worker and gemini:keys holds 5 keys — the defect is keypool.js's silent-failure design: readPool caught errors and returned [], kv() returned null on missing binding, writePool never verified persistence, so 'KV broken' was indistinguishable from 'zero keys' and adds could be claimed successful without confirmation. Files: keypool.js (rewrite), ui.js, keyboards.js, read.js, callbacks.js, router.js, gemini.js, media.js, ARCHITECTURE.md. node --check passes on all. NEXT: deploy via this push, then live verification of fix-01 (add key + free-text), fix-02 (add two/remove both), fix-03 (full tap-only cycle).

fixes.name: Root-cause and repair the Gemini key pool actually being empty in production despite keys being 'added' successfully
fixes.notes: Observed live: after Settings → Keys → Add confirms a key was added, plain free-text requests still reply 'I need the Gemini API key to file free-form notes...'. The pool the dispatch code reads at request time is empty regardless of what the Add flow appeared to do. Investigation checklist (confirm which is actually true in the live environment, in order): (a) is the placeholder KV id 0000... still what the deployed Worker is bound to (check Actions build logs for the latest successful deploy, wrangler.toml at the commit that deploy built from, and whether predeploy.mjs genuinely ran in that pipeline); (b) is predeploy.mjs wired into the actual build command the Workers Build runs, or does it only exist in the repo; (c) did predeploy.mjs run but fail silently; (d) did it create the namespace but the id it stamped never took effect for the deployed build (Workers Builds build from a git checkout — a runner-side file edit cannot persist). Then fix the root cause properly: the end state must be a real working KV namespace permanently bound as CODEX_KV in what the live Worker actually deploys from, self-sufficient across future deploys, no manual dashboard steps ever again. Also make KV binding failures LOUD: getKeys/addKeys/writePool must never silently behave as 'zero keys configured' when the binding is missing/non-functional. VERIFY FOR REAL: add a key through Settings → Keys → Add on the live bot, then send a plain free-text message and confirm it is filed (or at minimum no longer produces the 'I need the Gemini API key' message).
fixes.tested: LIVE STATE INSPECTED via Cloudflare API (2026-09-04): namespace f1ad0d7e42c3456c8f3f241c61a7b3d8 'CODEX_KV' exists; live Worker codex-bot IS bound to it; KV contains gemini:keys (5 keys) + sys:cmd_synced. So binding/provisioning was NOT the failure — the silent-swallow design in keypool.js was. Code fix implemented; LIVE BOT RE-TEST (add key via Settings → Keys → Add, then free-text) still pending post-deploy. | LIVE WRITE EVIDENCE 2026-09-04: pool grew 5→7 keys during session via live Add flow — KV persistence confirmed working post-deploy.
